purpose: Second-review proposals only. Do not treat this file as golden labels automatically.

policy.STRICT_ACCEPT: Use for retrieval metrics: all explicit technical properties match semantically and there is no material contradiction.
policy.BUSINESS_ALTERNATIVE: Likely usable engineering substitute, but execution differs enough that it should not broaden strict golden labels without human confirmation.
policy.UNSURE: Record contains conflicting/insufficient product semantics; requires human decision.

v2_q02.note: Keep strict golden on flat DN100 PN16 steel-20 flanges; material substitutions such as 09G2S/12X18N10T are intentionally excluded from strict eval.

v2_q03.note: 19027 matches DN65/PN16/09G2S but is a flat flange, not weld-neck/butt-weld.

v2_q04.note: The UNSURE Regula records are named as ball valves but catalog technical_properties identify variants as regulating valves. Human should decide whether Regula belongs in strict golden. h-90 is not inferred.

v2_q05.note: 19163 is a DN200 butterfly valve while query requires DN100.

v2_q06.note: 2911 adds a gearbox; 740 is prepared for electric actuator. Core steel/DN80/PN16/flanged requirements match, but these unusual control executions are kept out of strict golden pending human confirmation.

v2_q08.note: 17598 is an angular valve. It matches brass/DN25/male-female threading but is an unusual execution versus the generic query, so keep it outside strict golden unless accepted by business policy.

v2_q10.note: 5211 and 18481 are brass; 6529 is steel but welded PN40, while query requires steel coupling/threaded PN25.

v2_q11.note: 16361 is DN50 flanged manual with flange kit but PN40 (4 MPa), not required PN80 (8 MPa).

v2_q01.note: Expanded pool contains no gate-valve candidate matching the requested wedge gate valve DN100 PN16.

recommended_human_checks.question: Should Regula variants whose name says ball valve but product type says regulating valve count as strict analogues?
Should gearbox / electric-actuator-ready executions be accepted into strict golden when control method was not explicitly requested?
Should an angular DN25 brass male-female ball valve count as strict equivalent for a generic straight-layout query?
Should angular / union-nut DN20 PN40 brass variants be accepted as business alternatives only, or also strict equivalents?
